method: Fixed-seed samples drawn by backend/scripts/audit_renewal_radar.py. One reviewer, Claude, labelled each row from its title and description before seeing the classifier result. A row counts as correct if it is a recurring fire or security system service, or genuine adjacent passive fire or fire risk work.
independence_limit: The reviewer also wrote the rules, and there was no second reader. A commercial reviewer should repeat this before the figures are quoted outside the team.

rounds.rules: after round 2 fixes; fresh draw of the top 25 non-adjacent by annualised value and 40 random tier 1
rounds.overlap_note: High-value samples overlap between rounds because the top of the list is small.

errors_found: General building works held by Mitie Property Services (Camden)
Dynamic purchasing systems and framework lots counted as contracts
Same contract under two buyer names (Cheshire)
found_after_rejection: Fire alarm maintenance under a coded title (West Suffolk)
Fire safety equipment service and repair (Luton)
regression: Each listed error and miss is pinned in backend/tests/test_renewal_radar_integration.py.
known_weakness: Adjacent passive fire works are often one-off projects. They sit in tier 3 rather than being excluded. Manned security and CCTV monitoring contracts can still appear when the title names a system.
